ArxMetrics.title: ArxMetrics
ArxMetrics.description:
Compatibility metrics plus prediction-mode-explicit partition metrics.

``test_r2`` / ``test_rmse`` / ``mae`` historically mean one-step values. New code
must use ``one_step`` or ``free_run`` below so a value is never detached from the
prediction mode that produced it.

ComplianceProofData.title: ComplianceProofData
ComplianceProofData.description:
Machine-checked evidence that a plan obeys the frozen safety rules.

A plan whose proof does not pass is never executed, so this is the record of what was
verified rather than a promise about what the agent intends to do.

GeneralizationDiagnosticsData.title: GeneralizationDiagnosticsData
GeneralizationDiagnosticsData.description: A replay of the fixed winner; it never creates trials or changes a study.

LagCompensationRequest.title: LagCompensationRequest
LagCompensationRequest.description:
Apply an explicitly confirmed ARX ``nk`` alignment to input columns.

For this project ``y(k)`` depends on ``u(k-nk)``.  Applying ``nk=d`` therefore
writes source ``u(t-d)`` alongside unchanged ``y(t)`` and drops the leading boundary
rows that cannot be aligned.  The API never infers or applies a lag by itself.

optimized_test_fit.title: Optimized Test Fit
optimized_test_fit.description: Best Trial 固定后仅执行一次的 held-out Test 自由仿真 FIT。

excitation_shortfall.title: Excitation Shortfall
excitation_shortfall.description: 持续激励阶次低于 na+nb 的通道及其实际/所需阶次。这是诊断而非阻断：实测该判据无法区分可用与不可用的数据（见 ALG-0.2 §3）。

ModelValidationData.title: ModelValidationData
ModelValidationData.description:
Control-relevant acceptance evidence.

``free_run_fit`` is the primary metric: an APC controller predicts many steps ahead,
so one-step FIT — which is fed the measured previous output — flatters any model on an
autocorrelated process. ``one_step_fit`` is kept as a diagnostic, and a large
``fit_gap`` is itself the signal that the model is coasting on persistence.
